newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads Saudi man for murder.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads Saudi man for murder.

text.p: Saudi Arabia beheaded a Saudi man on Thursday for shooting to death a compatriot over a dispute, the state-run Saudi television said.
The television, quoting the interior ministry, said Mufareh al-Manjahi was beheaded in the Saudi region of Aseer.

Fifty-three people have been executed in the conservative Moslem kingdom so far this year. Saudi Arabia strictly enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading by the sword convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
